answer: A farm of 366 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in river, queued in velvet, and copper publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 58 identities per epoch. A farm of 4010 identities would post 3551 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
